Calculation.Text: /* fmIDE.GetMenuItemID ( pMenuItemName ; pOptionalMenuName ) Returns the ID number of the menu item of the given name. If multiple entries with the same name are found the id of the first entry is returned. Optionally a menu name can be passed to disambiguate. */ Let( [ vMenuItemSearchString = Case( not IsEmpty ( pOptionalMenuName ) ; pOptionalMenuName & Char ( 9 ) ) & pMenuItemName ]; +LeftWords ( MBS( "List.MatchesSubString"; MBS("Menubar.ListMenuCommands"); vMenuItemSearchString ) ; 1 ) )
